scope: Narrow D6-A composition correction: when the existing event-driven cloth/contact solver changes a supported ball into a state requiring 3D departure handling at an exact contact TOI, the unconsumed same-tick tail must enter the D6-A continuous integrator from that TOI. This gate does not weaken an initial-penetration guard, clamp a tick-end state, replay a full tick, publish D6-B telemetry, start D6-C classification, or authorize rules, product, UI, renderer, GPU, readiness, capture, threshold, profile, asset, CMake, or public-schema changes.

reproducible_blocker.interactive_control: BilliardsInteractivePhysicsTests fails the exact assertion 'every 120 Hz break tick must converge without physics failure'
reproducible_blocker.root_cause: The legacy contact solver produces a downward vertical velocity and Airborne domain for a previously ClothSupported ball late in tick 179, after the tick's D6-A branch has already run. Tick 180 correctly rejects the already-below-cloth initial state.

selected_composition_contract.handoff_trigger: An existing converged legacy event/island at absolute whole-tick TOI changes any non-pocketed supported ball to Airborne or otherwise creates a state that requires D6-A continuous 3D handling.
selected_composition_contract.handoff_state: Use the staged post-island position, velocity, angular state, support reaction/domain, pocket state, stable ball identity, event budget and gameplay-event state at the exact handoff TOI.
selected_composition_contract.tail_duration: original whole-tick duration minus the exact handoff TOI; never the original whole-tick duration and never an inferred duration from the invalid tick-end state
selected_composition_contract.candidate_order: The D6-A tail participates in the same absolute whole-tick TOI lineage. Contacts, table candidates, pocket transitions and later legacy candidates are ordered or fail closed under the existing tolerance and ambiguity contracts.
selected_composition_contract.single_integration: Every analytic interval is integrated exactly once. The legacy surface solver may not advance a handed-off ball through the tail, and D6-A may not replay the prefix.
selected_composition_contract.no_end_state_repair: A tick-end clamp, domain flip, support-height snap, velocity-y zeroing, state rewind without TOI lineage, or next-tick recovery does not satisfy this contract.
selected_composition_contract.initial_guard: The existing D6-A initial-below-cloth, rail-solid and outside-floor guards remain unchanged and continue to fail closed for genuinely invalid public input.
selected_composition_contract.implementation_shape: A private physics.cpp composition seam may split/recurse at the existing event TOI or merge one deterministic staged scheduler. It may call existing D6-A APIs/helpers but may not add a public result field or duplicate the rigid contact resolver.

atomicity_and_telemetry_contract.staging: The entire legacy prefix, handoff, D6-A tail, any later candidate and all pocket/domain/counter changes execute on one temporary whole-tick GameState.
atomicity_and_telemetry_contract.success_commit: Commit position, velocity, angularVelocity, rotationAxis, rotationAngle, speed, motionState, pocketed, pocket interaction, physicalDomain, capture sequence, pocket count, ballsMoving and gameplay events together only after the full tick succeeds.
atomicity_and_telemetry_contract.failure_rollback: Any legacy, handoff, D6-A tail, ambiguity, budget, nonfinite or passive-energy failure restores the exact pre-tick transactional state and publishes no partial success telemetry or private D6-A event list.
atomicity_and_telemetry_contract.legacy_contact_telemetry: Existing canonical PhysicsContactRecord and SolverEventRecord for the legacy prefix remain exactly once with the same contact TOI, island identity, impulse, residual, energy and position payload as the independently executed prefix.
atomicity_and_telemetry_contract.d6_private: D6-A handoff, return, landing and departure records remain physics-private and are not appended to canonical PhysicsStepTelemetry, ShotFacts, rules outcomes or product UI.
atomicity_and_telemetry_contract.surface_and_plane_lineage: Canonical surface-motion and requested plane-observation records cover each interval once, use absolute whole-tick times and segment ordinals, and contain neither gaps nor duplicate prefix/tail records.
atomicity_and_telemetry_contract.no_handoff_control: Ticks with no supported-to-D6 handoff remain byte/record equivalent to the existing legacy control path, including telemetry ordering and gameplay events.
atomicity_and_telemetry_contract.energy: Existing per-island and tick passive-energy tolerances remain unchanged; the composition layer may not add energy or multiply a tolerance by an unreported private event.

required_tests_first_red_fixtures_exact.requirement: Construct one existing legacy cloth ball-ball island at independent TOI t whose converged impulse gives a ClothSupported ball negative vertical velocity. Prove the same tick hands the post-island state to D6-A, produces the independently rooted ClothReturn in the remaining tail, never begins a later tick below support, and integrates prefix and tail once.

A legacy island that gives a supported ball positive vertical velocity hands it off as Airborne at the contact TOI. Independent ballistic/table roots prove the tail domain sequence, including a later landing when present, without a clamp or duplicate contact.

A no-contact tick and a converged legacy contact whose supported participants do not require D6-A remain byte-equivalent in GameState and record-equivalent in canonical telemetry to the pre-correction legacy path.

Whole-tick composition agrees within sealed solver tolerances with an independently executed legacy prefix at the exact event TOI followed by a D6-A tail. Absolute event ordering, stable ball identity, domains and transactional fields agree; a float horizon just before the TOI does not claim the handoff.

A handoff whose first D6-A candidate is indistinguishable from another legacy/table/pocket candidate at the same absolute TOI fails with the selected exact ambiguity code, empty committed private events and byte-exact whole-state rollback.

The shared whole-tick event budget counts the prefix island and tail candidates once. Exhaustion returns EventBudget with whole rollback; a genuine D6-A InvalidState or nonfinite failure propagates without being broadly translated to EventBudget.

The legacy contact and solver records emitted by a successful handoff case equal an independent prefix oracle field-for-field and occur exactly once. D6-A private return/landing/departure events do not grow canonical contact, solver or public schema denominators.

Requested plane crossings and analytic surface segments across the seam use absolute whole-tick time, strictly ordered segment ordinals and exact one-interval coverage. Prefix/tail duplication, gaps, local-time publication and incomplete attestations fail closed.

Failure injected before the legacy event, at handoff validation, during D6-A tail, during later legacy work and during final finite/energy validation restores every staged GameState field and publishes no partial success telemetry, gameplay event, pocket counter or domain mutation.

Direct public input already below cloth support or embedded in rail/outside geometry still fails the existing D6-A guard. Source and runtime mutations that weaken the guard, clamp y, zero vy, flip domain at tick end, replay the full dt, or delay repair to the next tick must fail.

The unchanged interactive GameRuntime rack, aim pi/2, power 80 and Shoot sequence advances at 1/120 second until rest: every tick succeeds, the run ends before 20000 ticks and within the existing CPU budget, and the former tick-180 ball-15 path includes at least one real same-tick handoff rather than passing because the break no longer reaches that topology.

Static audits prove the correction is confined to the exact allowlist, introduces no public D6-B telemetry field, ShotFacts/rules/product/UI/renderer/GPU consumer, coordinate whitelist, threshold or profile change, and leaves CMake unchanged.

tests_first_sequence: Add substantive CPU fixtures to the existing D6-A focused test and interactive control without changing production; freeze an honest RED whose first cause is the missing event-TOI handoff.
Root and independent TA reproduce the RED and verify all twelve fixtures, especially C07 telemetry equivalence, C09 rollback and C11 real break topology, before production authorization.

Implement only the minimum private composition seam in physics.cpp; table_departure_geometry files may be edited only if a separately proven API seam is impossible and Root explicitly revalidates that exact expansion.
Run focused O0/O2 with identical semantic output, InteractivePhysics O2, then the existing broad CPU physics targets. Do not configure a new target or run GPU/readiness/capture.
Freeze commands, source/object/binary/stdout/stderr hashes and a CPU implementation receipt. D6-A and downstream Release remain not source-stable until a separate independent acceptance.
